title: Profile mass assignment permits system administrator escalation
wrong: The validator parses but discards the sanitized result; updateMe passes the original body to Prisma, including systemRole and nested relations.
evidence: Authenticated PATCH /api/auth/me with {"name":"Audit","systemRole":"SUPER_ADMIN"} passes updateMeSchema (unknown keys are stripped only in the returned value) and reaches user.update unchanged. No live account modified.
fix: Assign parsed data back to req.body and allowlist profile fields in the controller; regression-test systemRole, clerkId and nested membership writes.

title: Authenticated arbitrary code execution on API host
wrong: Submitted code runs native interpreters with the API OS identity, filesystem/network access, inherited secrets and attacker-controlled environment. A timeout is not isolation.
evidence: Any signed-in user can POST /api/snippets/execute with JavaScript console.log(process.getuid?.()) or arbitrary fs/network calls; route has no workspace gate. Source establishes capability; dangerous execution was not performed.
fix: Disable exposed execution until moved to isolated disposable workers with no application secrets, denied network, resource/process limits and tenant quotas.

title: Yjs room prefix authorizes the wrong document
wrong: For document:ownWorkspace:victimDocument authentication checks the supplied workspace, while fetch/store use only victimDocument.
evidence: A member of A supplies room document:A:documentB. No comparison to documentB.workspaceId occurs. With a non-bypass RLS role the unscoped query fails instead (G01); with the supplied postgres setup this exposes B. Live exploit unverified.
fix: Resolve canonical document workspace first; compare room workspace and require role; use tenant-scoped fetch/store and reject missing documents.

title: Socket.io room joins expose other workspaces
wrong: Any authenticated socket joins any workspace ID and receives presence and future room broadcasts without membership verification.
evidence: Emit workspace:join {workspaceId:otherId,userName:"Audit"}; only Zod validation precedes join.
fix: Check membership using server identity before joining; evict on membership changes.

title: Kanban socket relays permit viewer and outsider spoofing
wrong: All four Kanban input events relay client content to arbitrary workspace rooms without role or resource checks. These handlers do not persist database changes.
evidence: Emit task-created/updated/deleted/moved targeting another workspace; socket.to does not require sender room membership.
fix: Accept authorized server mutations as canonical broadcasts; otherwise verify membership, editor role, resource ownership and bounded task schema.

title: Workspace owner can modify members in another workspace
wrong: Owner middleware checks URL workspace, but member update/delete uses memberId alone.
evidence: As owner of A PATCH /api/workspaces/A/members/memberB {role:"OWNER"}, or DELETE a non-owner memberB. WorkspaceMember has no RLS policy.
fix: Use composite workspace and member filters and transactionally enforce owner invariants.

title: Creating a column has no board authorization
wrong: Authenticated requests create columns on arbitrary boards; unlike update/delete there is no editor check.
evidence: POST /api/tasks/boards/otherBoard/columns {name:"Injected"}; Board/Column are not protected by the RLS migration.
fix: Resolve board workspace and require editor before reading positions or creating columns.

title: Yjs viewers can write
wrong: Hocuspocus authentication accepts all membership roles and never marks viewers read-only.
evidence: Connect as a VIEWER and send a Yjs update; auth returns the same context as an editor. No role decision before storage.
fix: Enforce server read-only connection state for viewers; test write attempts with raw protocol clients.

title: Cross-workspace document hierarchy can expose children
wrong: Document creation accepts any parentId; child includes do not filter workspace. The FK only enforces that a document exists.
evidence: Under the supplied bypass-RLS database role, editor A creates a document with parentId=documentB. Member B then reads children including A metadata/content in list nesting. Live DB reproduction unverified.
fix: Require parent workspace match and enforce tenant relationships at database level; scope recursive reads.

title: Membership removal and suspension do not revoke collaboration access
wrong: Authorization is checked at connection time only; no token expiry timer or role-change eviction is wired. Kill-switch/SCIM disconnect Socket.io, not Hocuspocus. isActive is not checked in REST/socket principal resolution.
evidence: Connect, remove/demote member or suspend tenant, then continue sending Yjs updates. Need authenticated integration fixture to verify connection lifetime.
fix: Enforce active user/tenant and current authorization throughout session; close all collaboration transports on revocation and expire sessions.

title: Public GET reset clears cookies and redirects externally
wrong: A public GET performs logout-like cookie deletion and accepts absolute/protocol-relative redirect destinations.
evidence: GET /api/auth/reset?redirect=https://example.com yields an external redirect while expiring same-origin cookies. Can be triggered by top-level cross-site navigation.
fix: Allowlist same-origin relative paths; use a protected POST for session changes and provider revocation.

title: Invites enumerate registered accounts and bypass acceptance
wrong: Workspace owners distinguish unregistered email, existing member and existing nonmember; invitation immediately inserts membership with no invitation/acceptance record.
evidence: Own any workspace, invite candidate emails and compare 404 vs success vs already-member error.
fix: Use pending invitations with normalized email, opaque responses, expiry, consent and per-owner limits.

title: SCIM provisioned identities conflict with Clerk and global profile state
wrong: SCIM email upsert creates a synthetic clerkId or edits an existing global user. Clerk sync upserts by real clerkId against unique email, without identity linking; isActive is global yet not enforced.
evidence: Provision new email via SCIM then sign in with that email via Clerk: unique email conflicts. Tenant token can change name/active/email on a shared user via its external identity.
fix: Design explicit verified identity linking and tenant-local provisioning state; enforce deprovisioning on every transport without mutating unrelated tenant identity.

title: AI markdown renders unsanitized HTML
wrong: Only code spans/blocks escape HTML; ordinary text passes raw HTML to dangerouslySetInnerHTML in editor previews and copilot.
evidence: markdownToHtml(``) returns executable markup. Feed equivalent model output to the preview; prompt injection provides an input path. No provider call needed to establish sink.
fix: Use a maintained Markdown parser with raw HTML disabled and sanitize allowed HTML/URLs before rendering or editor insertion.

title: Upload work is synchronous and authorized after buffering
wrong: Multer buffers up to 25MB before membership/role checks. OCR/PDF parsing runs in API with no concurrency/page/pixel budget or request deadline; MIME is client-controlled.
evidence: An authenticated outsider can repeatedly upload 25MB before receiving 403; authorized compressed image/PDF workloads can exhaust CPU/RAM.
fix: Authorize before multipart parsing; verify file signatures and dimensions; queue bounded isolated parsing with deadlines and rate limits.

title: Payload validation leaves broad unbounded content surfaces
wrong: Document JSON has no node/depth schema; AI body has only truthiness checks; socket tasks/cursors are any; 10MB HTTP JSON and ws default limits are large relative to workloads.
evidence: Submit object prompt or malformed TipTap content, or large arbitrary cursor/task graphs; no domain schema rejects them before downstream use.
fix: Add bounded domain schemas for body/params/query and each event; explicit message/document size, rate and nesting limits.

title: AI quota is neither accurate nor atomic
wrong: Metering counts prompt/context characters only after HTTP success, excluding output tokens and retrieved context. Concurrent requests all pass preflight; a streaming error still ends with HTTP 200. Quotas disabled without Stripe configuration; agents bypass metering.
evidence: Compare max_tokens=1024 to Math.ceil(input.length/4); send parallel requests near limit. Source confirms no reservation and no provider usage accounting.
fix: Reserve a bounded token budget atomically, settle real provider usage including agents/retrieval, enforce tenant/user concurrency and retry usage reporting durably.

title: Public completion bypasses configured AI gateway
wrong: Interactive SSE calls Groq directly, with no application deadline, disconnect cancellation or fallback. The timeout/circuit-breaker gateway is used only by task agent.
evidence: Stall a provider stream or disconnect the browser: no AbortController/request close handler exists. SDK defaults may time out; no claim of infinite SDK timeout.
fix: Use a shared streaming gateway with explicit deadlines, cancellation, safe error frames, retries and documented fallback semantics.

title: Retrieved content can inject instructions and include archived documents
wrong: Retrieval filters workspace correctly but omits isArchived=false. Document/PR content is supplied as user instructions without untrusted-context boundaries. No demonstrated cross-workspace RAG query leak.
evidence: Archive an embedded document then query its topic; SQL still selects it. Seed content instructing output HTML to exercise E02 through AI. Model obedience remains unverified.
fix: Filter archived/deleted content, minimize context and delimit untrusted evidence; prevent content from becoming executable HTML; document provider data handling.

title: RLS context is missing from most protected-table operations
wrong: Only selected document/snippet list/create and task agent operations set tenant context. Document access checks, update/delete, Yjs persistence, most tasks, search, webhooks and embedding worker use the unscoped client. Supplied postgres credentials bypass RLS, concealing defects.
evidence: Run production queries as a NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS role: direct protected-table reads see no rows/writes fail. Run as Compose postgres: RLS is bypassed. Existing RLS tests construct separate tables and do not test controllers.
fix: Make tenant-bound transactions mandatory end-to-end and supply least-privilege DB roles; integration-test all matrix paths against actual migrations.

title: Migrations cannot bootstrap a fresh database
wrong: First migration alters existing tables but no baseline creates User/Workspace/Document/etc. clerkId is nullable in SQL but required in schema. README uses db push, omitting SQL RLS policies and indexes.
evidence: On empty PostgreSQL with vector installed, first ALTER TABLE User fails. Existing databases also need explicit identity backfill/NOT NULL handling before auth migration.
fix: Create and validate historical baseline and backfill path; use migrate deploy with a dedicated migration role; test empty and upgrade databases.

title: Redis outage blocks purported graceful fallback
wrong: isRedisAvailable awaits ping with unlimited reconnect/offline command retries. Cache get/del likewise await redis commands. Outage can hang snippet reads, joins, adapters and task moves instead of returning false.
evidence: Stop Redis then await isRedisAvailable or a cache read: no command timeout or bounded retry is configured. Runtime log shows repeated ECONNREFUSED.
fix: Separate queue and request clients; use fail-fast request commands, bounded health checks, circuit breaker and tested fallback.

title: Embedding producer and dedicated worker use different queues
wrong: queueEmbedding writes PostgreSQL EmbeddingJob; worker.ts listens to BullMQ devsync-embedding and never drains that table. API polling is opt-in only.
evidence: Create a resource then run npm run worker: no BullMQ embedding job is enqueued. Verify table backlog and absent embedding.
fix: Use one durable producer/consumer mechanism with transactional outbox and acknowledged retries.

title: Embedding polling races and loses failed work
wrong: Polling SELECT and processing UPDATE are not atomic across replicas; crashed processing rows are never reclaimed. embed catches failures and returns null, refresh returns success, and job is deleted. Requeued concurrent edits can be deleted by older work.
evidence: Two API replicas with RUN_EMBEDDING_WORKER_IN_API=true select the same pending row. Provider failure returns null then DELETE executes.
fix: Claim with SKIP LOCKED/lease and version; retry provider errors, reclaim leases and preserve newer content revisions.

title: Yjs state and JSON projections diverge
wrong: CRDT stores update only yjsState, while embeddings/search/agents use content JSON. REST and agent JSON updates do not modify Yjs; editor imports JSON only when yjsState absent.
evidence: Edit a persisted Yjs document, inspect content/search: old JSON remains. Append agent summary after yjsState exists: client ignores new JSON.
fix: Choose canonical Yjs state and transactionally derive JSON/indexing; apply server edits through CRDT, with deterministic legacy migration.

title: Kanban move and position allocation race
wrong: Move increments target tasks then updates moving task in separate operations, never closes source gap. Creation uses max+1 without serialization/unique constraint. Summary append also read-modify-writes JSON concurrently.
evidence: Concurrent creates/moves can duplicate positions; error between increment and task update leaves partial mutation. Two summary jobs can overwrite appends.
fix: Use ordered transactional mutations with version/locking or order keys; serialize summary append or use append-only records.

title: GitHub task transition crosses workspace boundary
wrong: Signed repository event searches globally unique taskKey without filtering owning workspace then moves all matches into the repository workspace.
evidence: Repository A PR references a known DEV-123 from B; under supplied bypass-RLS DB, matching B task moves to A. Strict RLS instead yields no rows (G01).
fix: Filter task through column.board.workspaceId and enforce immutable tenant ownership; transactionally validate source and target.

title: Webhook delivery is acknowledged before business effects
wrong: Idempotency wrapper covers inserting delivery record only; completed marker is set before processing/enqueue/move. Later failures are suppressed as duplicate on redelivery. Stripe has signature validation but no event ledger/order guard.
evidence: Force failure after GitHubWebhookDelivery insert, redeliver same delivery: 202 duplicate, work never retried. Older Stripe checkout completion can overwrite canceled status.
fix: Persist incoming delivery and outbox atomically; process/retry durable state, mark done only after effects; deduplicate/order Stripe events.

title: Persistence errors are swallowed after CRDT update acknowledgement
wrong: Yjs store catches DB errors and resolves normally, making failed persistence appear successful. Debounce also leaves 3–10 seconds of acknowledged in-memory edits at risk on abrupt restart.
evidence: Make database unavailable during store, observe error log but no rejected store/retry signal. Kill API before debounce expires.
fix: Propagate failed stores for retry, expose durable acknowledgements, journal updates before confirming durability and test crash recovery.

title: Fire-and-forget embedding promises can reject unhandled
wrong: Async queueEmbedding calls after res.json are neither awaited nor caught; controller catch cannot catch later rejection. Similar calls exist in snippets/tasks/ingestion.
evidence: Cause EmbeddingJob INSERT failure after successful create/update; rejected promise has no handler and can terminate Node.
fix: Persist outbox in mutation transaction or explicitly catch and durably retry failures.

title: Missing relation indexes and unbounded lists amplify load
wrong: Document workspaceId/parentId, Board workspaceId, Column boardId, Task columnId, Snippet workspaceId and Activity workspaceId/createdAt lack ordinary query indexes. Lists return full documents/code/boards/tasks without pagination; PostgreSQL does not automatically index referencing FKs.
evidence: Inspect schema plus SQL migrations: vector indexes exist, most FK/list indexes do not. Seed a large workspace and EXPLAIN representative queries to quantify (unverified performance).
fix: Add measured composite indexes, cursor pagination, projections and payload budgets; avoid broad nested list includes.

title: Local-first Kanban is a last-writer-wins JSON snapshot with no retry
wrong: Boards use one Y.Map string value containing the entire board, so concurrent edits to different tasks replace each other. Failed REST mutations show a promise of retry, but no outbox/replay exists. Server persists only document rooms, not kanban rooms.
evidence: Go offline, add task, reconnect/reload: only local snapshot exists and loadBoards overwrites with server data. Two clients set record:boards/value concurrently: Yjs resolves one whole JSON value.
fix: Model per-task CRDT entries or keep server versioned operations with durable mutation outbox; reconcile optimistic IDs and rollback rejected writes.

title: Kanban load effect can fetch indefinitely
wrong: localBoards changes identity whenever its observed value changes; loadBoards depends on it and effect calls loadBoards, which writes localBoards again.
evidence: Load endpoint returns JSON; localBoards.set triggers observer/React value update, recreates callback, retriggers effect. Browser confirmation blocked by authenticated fixture.
fix: Stabilize write callbacks and separate initial fetch from observers; version sync and test that idle board emits bounded requests.

title: Document rehydration can overwrite offline edits
wrong: Legacy JSON initialization is not coordinated with IndexedDB and remote sync; no atomic migration marker. Multiple clients importing legacy state can duplicate or replace content.
evidence: Existing local Yjs edits plus API doc.content with empty yjsState cause setContent on metadata load. Two first clients importing JSON create distinct CRDT structures.
fix: Initialize legacy CRDT server-side once; wait for local/remote sync and never replace populated local state.

title: Collaboration memory and rooms have no application quotas
wrong: Arbitrary event names allocate buckets indefinitely per socket; room joins have rate but no total count cap; empty fallback presence maps are retained. Hocuspocus accepts arbitrary nonexistent IDs and no document-size/room-count quotas.
evidence: Send unique event names or many room joins over time; disconnect clears buckets/socket mapping but not empty workspace maps. 10+ editor capacity is unmeasured.
fix: Allowlist event names, cap rooms/update sizes/state, prune empty maps and load-test bounded memory/reconnect behavior.

title: Presence is incorrect across tabs and reconnects
wrong: Presence keyed by user stores one socket; closing one tab deletes another live tab. TTL refresh occurs only on join; idle live users expire. Client expects userId/userName but server emits id/name; only overview joins workspace and reconnect does not rejoin explicitly.
evidence: Open two tabs, close one; inspect hash entry. Wait >300s with no join. View presence bar initials (uses absent userName).
fix: Track per-socket presence with heartbeat and aggregation, consistent DTOs, centralized route membership and reconnect rejoin.

title: SSE parsers drop split network frames
wrong: Each network chunk is parsed independently; JSON split across reads is caught and discarded. Decoder is not used with streaming mode; SSE error frames ignored. Same parser repeated in editor/snippets.
evidence: Split data: {"content":"hello"} across two fetch reader chunks: neither fragment parses.
fix: Use one buffered incremental UTF-8/SSE parser shared by all consumers with error/cancel support.

title: Local cache survives logout and is not scoped by user
wrong: IndexedDB key contains room only, not user identity; signOut does not destroy/delete cached documents. Another account on shared browser can access stale data locally. Copilot/command palette also retain state across workspace navigation.
evidence: Sign out then sign in as another user in same origin/browser; inspect devsync:room IndexedDB. No logout cache removal in AuthProvider.
fix: Isolate encrypted local stores by account, define logout retention policy and clear/invalidate sensitive view state on identity/workspace changes.

title: Authentication token callbacks destabilize socket lifecycle
wrong: Auth value recreates getToken on user/auth memo changes. SocketProvider depends on it and lacks disposed guard around pending token promise. Local-first hook captures one token string, with no refresh callback.
evidence: Unmount before getToken resolves: SocketProvider can create an orphan socket. Expired token reconnect reuses captured token.
fix: Use stable callbacks, disposed guards and provider-supported token refresh; destroy Y.Doc instances and reset stores on room changes.

title: Keyboard access and dialog semantics are missing
wrong: Task cards rely on div onClick/native mouse drag, no keyboard move actions/tabIndex; modals lack dialog role, focus trapping, Escape and restoration; icon controls lack names and labels are unassociated.
evidence: Keyboard-only navigation cannot focus task card or move it. Dashboard create modal is a generic div (dashboard/page.tsx:132).
fix: Implement accessible buttons/cards, keyboard move menu, labeled form controls and tested dialog primitives. Measure contrast in authenticated UI before asserting ratios.

title: Workspace settings and billing are nonfunctional mock screens
wrong: Settings inputs are not loaded or saved; delete button has no handler. Billing hardcodes active enterprise plan, quotas and enabled statuses without API data/actions.
evidence: Read settings component (no handlers/state/API). Billing tiers current:true unconditionally, connected node status static.
fix: Connect real authorized workspace/billing APIs and render unavailable/pending states honestly.

title: History and operational analytics present fabricated state
wrong: History lists fixed checkpoints and restore only toasts success. Overview claims 3 workers and a connected repository regardless of health; sprint burndown fabricates historical points.
evidence: Select Restore This Checkpoint: no state/API mutation. Overview fixed devsync/enterprise-app and sub-ms retrieval text, with no benchmark.
fix: Remove fake success/metrics or label demo data explicitly; derive state/history from durable measured sources.

title: Mobile sidebar and localized UX need work
wrong: Sidebar defaults to 240px at all breakpoints within a flex row; content at 390px competes for remaining width. Hardcoded English/date locale and no i18n system; contrast/hydration/bundle totals unmeasured.
evidence: Inspect w-60 and no mobile overlay breakpoint; utils.ts uses en-US. Verify full mobile workflow with authenticated screenshots.
fix: Use collapsed/overlay mobile navigation and focus handling; introduce locale strategy when required and measure responsive layouts.

title: Dependency audit reports vulnerable installed trees
wrong: Backend registry audit reports 49 advisory entries (2 critical,12 high,31 moderate,4 low). Counts include transitive/meta-vulnerabilities and are not proven exploits. Frontend audit reports 73 entries (2 critical,16 high,54 moderate,1 low); see frontend-audit-escalated.json.
evidence: See backend-audit-escalated.json for exact versions, advisory URLs, ranges and remediation. Multer install warns version 1.x is vulnerable. Primary maintainer advisories: https://github.com/expressjs/multer/security/advisories (checked 2026-10-31).
fix: Triage reachable production dependencies first; update minimally with contract/security regression tests and regenerate locks. Do not use audit fix --force blindly.

title: Security tests fail compilation; E2E is skipped without fixtures
wrong: RLS tests import PostgreSqlContainer from a package that does not export it; queue test Worker generics fail compilation. E2E tests skip without credentials. Frontend has no test script and backend no lint script.
evidence: See backend-tests-escalated.log, backend-e2e.log, backend-lint.log and frontend-tests.log. Frontend lint reports 52 errors/53 warnings.
fix: Repair tests without bypassing type/security checks; add real controller/transport authz tests and authenticated isolated E2E fixtures; require explicit quality scripts.

title: Independent Railway workflow deploys without quality gate
wrong: Railway deploy triggers on main independently of the quality/security pipeline, so failing tests/scans need not prevent deployment. Action tags/CLI are not immutable.
evidence: Both workflows trigger push main; deploy.yml has no dependency on quality or scan.
fix: Use one gated pipeline with protected environment, immutable verified artifacts, pinned actions/CLI and migration/rollback approval policy.

title: Cluster ingress and collaboration scaling are incomplete
wrong: API ingress routes only /api; /socket.io and /yjs fall through web ingress. API has 3–12 replicas but Hocuspocus has no cross-instance document fanout; Socket.io Redis adapter does not synchronize Yjs. Polling also needs stickiness.
evidence: Deploy manifests as written, request /yjs or /socket.io on ingress: routed to web. Connect two editors to different API pods: independent in-memory CRDT states overwrite persisted full snapshots. Runtime cluster reproduction unverified.
fix: Route all protocols with TLS/timeouts; use supported cross-node Yjs persistence/fanout, sticky polling or documented websocket-only strategy and multi-pod convergence tests.

title: Autoscaler monitors different Redis keys than application queues
wrong: KEDA keys use colon-separated devsync:agent:pr-summary while queue name is devsync-agent-pr-summary. minReplicaCount:0 permits worker scale-to-zero with no matching wakeup metric.
evidence: Compare QueueNames in backend/src/lib/queue.ts:20 to listName. Embedding work has no scaler either.
fix: Verify actual BullMQ Redis keys, use supported scaler for waiting/delayed work and keep a safe floor until validated.

title: Compose configuration cannot reproduce documented stack
wrong: Redis configured allkeys-lru mixes durable queue/idempotency with evictable cache. No worker or migration service. Backend omits GROQ_API_KEY. Frontend runtime public vars/Clerk key are not supplied as Docker build args.
evidence: Inspect Compose and frontend Dockerfile: build declares only API/socket args and no Clerk key. New DB hits G02; AI backend key missing unless separately injected.
fix: Separate durable queues from cache with noeviction, add explicit migration/worker lifecycle, supply public build config securely and health-based dependency startup.

title: Terraform and Redis deployment need validation
wrong: Several HCL blocks contain multiple same-line attributes without valid multiline separation; inline comma-separated attributes also appear. Redis cluster-mode infrastructure is paired with standalone ioredis client; MOVED handling not configured.
evidence: Terraform executable validation not yet available: syntax concern unverified until terraform fmt -check/validate. Source explicitly uses new Redis rather than Redis.Cluster against a cluster configuration endpoint.
fix: Validate HCL in CI, initialize pinned provider lockfile, align Redis topology/client and test BullMQ cluster slots/TLS; provision dependencies referenced by manifests.

title: License and disclosure policy are absent
wrong: README claims MIT but no tracked LICENSE; no SECURITY.md or format config. Root gitignore *.log also hides raw audit evidence unless explicitly force-added.
evidence: Tracked inventory has README claim but no license/security policy; frontend ESLint and strict TS configs do exist.
fix: Add license with owner approval, security disclosure policy, formatter and documented explicit evidence tracking.

title: README and deployment guide describe obsolete identity and stack
wrong: README claims Next14, custom JWT rotation, SWR and Llama3; manifests/code use Next16.2.4, Clerk, Zustand/local state/Axios and gpt-oss-20b. Deployment lists JWT secrets but not current Clerk/Redis/billing configuration. Clone URL is placeholder.
evidence: Compare manifests, auth middleware, ai.controller.ts and DEPLOYMENT.md against README lines. Frontend requires Node>=20.9, contrary to Node18+ prerequisite.
fix: Rewrite onboarding from tested manifests and deploy target; unify identity, environment and migration instructions.

title: Feature and enterprise walkthrough claims exceed implementation
wrong: Snippet UI offers 12 languages and plain escaped code without syntax highlighting. README role management UI is absent in settings, invitations require registered users. Walkthrough describes raw y-websocket and API-drained embeddings despite Hocuspocus/dedicated mismatched worker. It refers to two env examples; frontend example absent.
evidence: Compare snippets LANGUAGES and <code>, settings page, worker/service producer and tracked inventory. Backend .env.example exists; do not call it missing.
fix: Maintain supported-feature matrix with limitations; add frontend env template and replace walkthrough protocol/worker/setup steps with verified operations.

title: Document upload sends bearer token to hardcoded localhost
wrong: Upload ignores configured API origin and always sends the Clerk bearer token to plaintext localhost:5000. Deployed users cannot ingest through the backend; any local listener receives that request/token if browser permits it.
evidence: Open ingestion UI from deployed origin: network target is user machine localhost, not NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL. Browser mixed-content/private-network behavior varies; successful token delivery unverified.
fix: Use the centralized configured API client and secure deployment origin; test upload on real HTTPS deployment.

title: Landing page claims end-to-end encryption unsupported by data flow
wrong: Document plaintext/JSON and Yjs bytes are available to the API/database; content is sent to AI providers. Repository secret encryption at rest does not provide end-to-end document encryption. Infinite scale and universally tenant-scoped workflow claims also exceed demonstrated behavior.
evidence: Inspect yjs persistence, content JSON, AI retrieval and D02/G08; no client document encryption/key exchange exists.
fix: Remove unsupported encryption/scaling claims and publish an accurate trust/data-processing model.

title: Light theme and toast color configuration conflict
wrong: Dark variables override :root unconditionally, so selecting light still retains dark base palette. Toaster wraps hex CSS variables in hsl(), producing invalid colors.
evidence: Toggle theme; class changes but :root still matches the later dark declaration. hsl(var(--card)) resolves to hsl(#0f1422).
fix: Scope dark overrides to .dark and use var(--card) directly; verify both themes and contrast.

title: Document templates omit template content
wrong: createFromTemplate passes title only, despite structured template content being defined above. createDocumentSchema does not accept content.
evidence: Select an ADR template: created document receives title but no template.content in request.
fix: Version or extend create contract deliberately to accept validated initial content and initialize canonical CRDT once.

title: Task assignments accept users outside the workspace
wrong: Task create/update accepts any User ID; foreign key existence is the only assignment constraint, without checking WorkspaceMember.
evidence: As editor of A, submit assigneeId of user B who is not an A member. include assignee returns B name/avatar and causes activity attribution by the agent. Live reproduction requires isolated DB fixtures.
fix: Require assignee membership in task workspace in the authorized transaction; validate removal/reassignment behavior.

title: Owner role updates can orphan a workspace
wrong: An owner can demote the last OWNER, including self; removal guard alone does not prevent an ownerless workspace and agent workflows depend on an OWNER.
evidence: PATCH own membership from OWNER to VIEWER when sole owner: no count/invariant check. Concurrent owner demotions also lack serialization.
fix: Define owner-transfer policy and transactionally preserve at least one owner, with contention tests.

title: Seed command refers to a missing file
wrong: db:seed executes prisma/seed.ts but no such file is tracked. Fresh seeded test/development setup is not reproducible.
evidence: Run npm run db:seed in an isolated installed copy: module cannot resolve missing seed.ts. Source inventory establishes absence.
fix: Provide deterministic non-production seed fixtures and document their scope.
